(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4))))
    (define frames (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0)))
    (define (inside-frame? r c frame)
      (and (> r (obj-r1 frame)) (< r (obj-r2 frame))
           (> c (obj-c1 frame)) (< c (obj-c2 frame))))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                [c (in-range (cols g))])
      (if (and (= (at g r c) 2)
               (not (eq? (find-first (lambda (frame) (inside-frame? r c frame)) frames) #f)))
          (set-cell out r c 4)
          out))))
